source: 上外版(SFLEP)必修第一册 Unit 3 Glossary 真词(跳过 △ 超纲词与专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、旅行主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。补充词均取自本单元 unit text(Reading A 罗马游记 / Reading B 旅行建议)的常见课标旅行词。

words.example_en: In Rome I finally saw the famous masterpieces I had only read about.
words.example_cn: 在罗马,我终于看到了那些我此前只在书里读过的著名杰作。

words.example_en: The museum is full of ancient sculptures made of stone and metal.
words.example_cn: 这座博物馆里满是用石头和金属制成的古代雕像。

words.example_en: The painted ceiling of the chapel was the best part of my whole trip.
words.example_cn: 教堂那绘满壁画的天花板是我整趟旅行最精彩的部分。

words.example_en: The view was so beautiful that I could not tear my eyes away from it.
words.example_cn: 那景色太美了,我的目光怎么也舍不得移开。

words.example_en: Some food sold to tourists is not very good in quality.
words.example_cn: 卖给游客的一些食物质量不太好。

words.example_en: I made an effort to find a restaurant that served local meals.
words.example_cn: 我努力找到了一家供应当地餐食的餐馆。

words.example_en: I wanted to taste the popular meals of the region.
words.example_cn: 我想品尝这个地区受欢迎的餐食。

words.example_en: The city has many luxury stores as well as cheaper shops.
words.example_cn: 这座城市既有许多奢侈品店,也有较便宜的商铺。

words.example_en: I looked for souvenirs that were in my price range.
words.example_cn: 我寻找在我价位范围内的纪念品。

words.example_en: The Christmas market was a perfect opportunity to buy presents.
words.example_cn: 那个圣诞集市是个买礼物的绝佳机会。

words.example_en: Some lessons may not seem relevant to your travel dreams right now.
words.example_cn: 有些课程现在看来也许与你的旅行梦想关系不大。

words.example_en: Study skills help you analyse the world around you before you travel.
words.example_cn: 学习技能帮助你在出行前分析周遭的世界。

words.example_en: Planning a trip teaches you to process information quickly.
words.example_cn: 规划一次旅行能教你迅速处理信息。

words.example_en: These skills will help you overcome the difficulties that stop you from travelling.
words.example_cn: 这些技能会帮你克服那些阻碍你出行的困难。

words.example_en: Dream big, but stay practical when you make a travel plan.
words.example_cn: 做旅行计划时要敢于做大梦,但也要切合实际。

words.example_en: A small setback won't prevent you from reaching your travel dreams.
words.example_cn: 小小的挫折不会阻止你实现旅行的梦想。

words.example_en: Travel was a goal that I had wanted to reach for many years.
words.example_cn: 旅行是我多年来一直想实现的一个目标。

words.example_en: The amount of money your family can spend will shape the trip.
words.example_cn: 家里能花的钱数会决定这趟旅行的样子。

words.example_en: Cost is an important factor when you plan where to travel.
words.example_cn: 在规划去哪里旅行时,花费是一个重要因素。

words.example_en: Your budget will determine whether you visit Europe or stay nearby.
words.example_cn: 你的预算将决定你是去欧洲还是待在附近。

words.example_en: You could participate in a student exchange programme abroad.
words.example_cn: 你可以参加一个出国的学生交流项目。

words.example_en: A student exchange is a cheaper way to travel and learn.
words.example_cn: 学生交流是一种更便宜的旅行兼学习的方式。

words.example_en: I hope you will maintain your travel dreams in spite of the limits.
words.example_cn: 我希望你尽管有种种限制,仍能保持你的旅行梦想。

words.example_en: Work hard and chart a course ahead before your journey begins.
words.example_cn: 在旅程开始前,努力做事并提前规划好路线。

words.example_en: It is wise to plan ahead so that your trip runs smoothly.
words.example_cn: 提前规划是明智之举,这样旅行才能顺利进行。

words.example_en: Stay rooted in the practical actions that bring your dream closer.
words.example_cn: 扎根于那些让梦想更近一步的实际行动。

words.example_en: We set off early for the long journey to the mountains.
words.example_cn: 我们一大早就出发,踏上去山里的漫长旅程。

words.example_en: Eleanor spent a wonderful holiday in Rome last week.
words.example_cn: 埃莉诺上周在罗马度过了一个美妙的假期。

words.example_en: Every year millions of tourists come to see the ancient ruins.
words.example_cn: 每年都有数百万游客前来观看这些古代遗址。

words.example_en: The Bell Tower is one of the city's most famous attractions.
words.example_cn: 钟楼是这座城市最著名的景点之一。

words.example_en: Xi'an is a popular travel destination for foreign visitors.
words.example_cn: 西安是外国游客喜爱的旅游目的地。

words.example_en: She prefers a city with beautiful scenery and a long history.
words.example_cn: 她偏爱一座既有美丽风景又有悠久历史的城市。

words.example_en: I would strongly recommend Xi'an for your winter trip.
words.example_cn: 我会强烈推荐你冬天去西安旅行。

words.example_en: Xu Xiake was a famous explorer who travelled across China.
words.example_cn: 徐霞客是一位走遍中国的著名探险家。

words.example_en: For years he visited mountains, valleys and caves all over China.
words.example_cn: 多年来,他游遍了中国各地的高山、深谷和洞穴。

words.example_en: He recorded his travel experiences in a famous travel book.
words.example_cn: 他把自己的旅行经历记录在一本著名的游记里。

words.example_en: As a teenager, you have some limitations when making travel plans.
words.example_cn: 作为青少年,你在制定旅行计划时会有一些限制。

words.example_en: Many young people dream of travelling far from home.
words.example_cn: 许多年轻人梦想着去远离家乡的地方旅行。

words.example_en: You can't imagine how lovely the old city is until you go there.
words.example_cn: 不到那里,你无法想象这座古城有多美。

words.example_en: The streets were lit with bright Christmas decorations.
words.example_cn: 街道上点缀着明亮的圣诞装饰。

words.example_en: The huge theatre is one of the greatest wonders ever built.
words.example_cn: 那座巨大的剧场是有史以来建成的最伟大的奇迹之一。

words.example_en: Rome is an ancient city that is full of ruins and history.
words.example_cn: 罗马是一座满是遗迹和历史的古老城市。

words.example_en: You can hardly believe how old the ruins of the temples are.
words.example_cn: 你几乎无法相信这些神庙的遗迹有多古老。

words.example_en: At the stand I looked for some souvenirs to take home for my friends.
words.example_cn: 在摊位前,我找了些纪念品带回家送给朋友。

words.example_en: The airline allows only one carry-on item of luggage for free.
words.example_cn: 这家航空公司只允许免费携带一件随身行李。

words.example_en: We spent the whole afternoon exploring the narrow old streets.
words.example_cn: 我们整个下午都在游览那些狭窄的老街。

words.example_en: On the last day we checked out and departed from the airport.
words.example_cn: 最后一天我们退了房,从机场出发离开。

words.example_en: After we arrived, we registered at the hotel near the airport.
words.example_cn: 到达后,我们在机场附近的酒店办理了入住登记。
